title: A Royal Christmas Holiday
description: An ambitious reporter tracks down a prince who is in town for the dedication of a naval museum honoring his late grandfather. She convinces him to show his followers that his work is more than just a job, and the two begin to fall for each other.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E31 — The Guitar Player Returns
Jim Lindsey, a guitarist from Mayberry who becomes famous while playing in a band, returns to town after failing his solo career.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S01 E32 — Bringing Up Opie
Aunt Bee scolds Opie and tells him to stay away from the courthouse after he handcuffs a classmate to a flagpole; Opie, annoyed at the situation, decides to run away from home.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E01 — Opie and the Bully
Andy learns that a bully has been demanding Opie's milk money at school. Andy must decide whether to intervene or let Opie deal with the bully and learn to stand up for himself.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E02 — Barney's Replacement
Barney resigns when he believes Andy is trying to ease him out of his job as deputy.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E03 — Andy and the Woman Speeder
An attractive out-of-town woman gets a speeding ticket from Andy. While waiting for her trial, she uses flattery and bribes to sway the witnesses for the prosecution.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E04 — Mayberry Goes Bankrupt
A citizen of Mayberry forestalls his eviction by trying to redeem a century-old municipal bond.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E05 — Barney on the Rebound
Barney becomes smitten with Melissa after he helps her cross the street and soon has dinner with her and her supposed dad. Before Barney can realize what is happening, she announces that they are engaged.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E06 — Opie's Hobo Friend
Andy and Opie go fishing and encounter an unhoused person, who later becomes friends with Opie and negatively impacts his conscience.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E07 — Crime-Free Mayberry
A bogus FBI agent and his accomplice nearly make off with the Mayberry bank's money.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E08 — The Perfect Female
Thelma Lou and Barney play matchmaker for Andy and Karen, Thelma Lou's attractive cousin. However, Barney slips up, making Karen think that Andy is as crude as Barney makes him out to be.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E09 — Aunt Bee's Brief Encounter
Aunt Bee hires Mr Wheeler, an itinerant handyman, to help around the Taylor home. She has taken a liking to him, but Andy discovers that he is actually a freeloader.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E10 — The Clubmen
Andy accepts a friend's offer to join an exclusive club and brings along Barney, who makes a fool of himself by putting on airs. Andy soon learns that only he has been selected for membership.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S01 E01 — Return to Crossroad Springs
When Willis falls off his horse, siblings James and Janet are forced to return home from their respective careers to help on the family ranch.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S01 E02 — Wolf on the Range
James reconnects with Maggie, the café owner; the Hamilton's deal with a wolf spotted on their property; Lewis looks for work.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S01 E03 — A Quarry Divided
Willis is reluctant to let James, Janet, and Amy help with his secret plans to expand the ranch.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S01 E04 — Storm on the Horizon
A big storm hits Crossroad Springs as the community comes together to help in the aftermath; Willis is helped by an unlikely neighbor.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S01 E05 — A Turn in the Road
The Hamilton's get closer to purchasing the quarry land; Janet helps deliver Tina's baby.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S01 E06 — Sunrise and Still Water
James prepares to return to his pastor life in Chicago; a member of the Newman family returns and threatens the Hamilton's land deal.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S01 E07 — Stay in Your Lane
As spring arrives in Crossroad Springs, James launches his Cowboy Church amid his family's struggles with drought, pride and rivalry with the Newmans.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S01 E08 — The Divine Search
As the past resurfaces, James questions his calling; Janet fights to protect her family; Willis gambles the ranch on one last choice.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S01 E09 — Patience
James must choose between the ranch and the church he built; tensions rise with Janet and Layla; Willis faces the cost of holding on.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S01 E10 — Joy
On Easter Sunday, James opens the Cowboy Church as faith calls for sacrifice, forgiveness, and hope amid a quiet threat to the ranch's future.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S02 E01 — Boots on the Ground
Maggie and James launch a food pantry as a surprise arrival threatens to upend life in Crossroad Springs.

title: Crossroad Springs
description:
S02 E02 — The Dust Settles
The Hamiltons continue navigating delays to their ranch expansion; familiar faces and new beginnings bring fresh energy to Crossroad Springs; Cody McIntyre returns to help local ranchers from the air; the Newman family begins settling into town.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E14 — The Ape
Adam and Little Joe warn Hoss when he tries to help Arnie, a man with the mind of a child and an uncontrollable temper.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E15 — The Blood Line
An Easterner swears revenge for the death of his father, a drunk that a Cartwright killed in self-defense.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E16 — The Courtship
Hoss falls prey to a beautiful woman with a gambling addiction and refuses to believe she's only interested in his money.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E17 — The Spitfire
Maud Hoad leads her revenge-seeking family against Joe, who was forced to shoot treacherous Jeb Hoad.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E19 — The Gunmen
Little Joe and Hoss are mistaken for gunmen while in a small Texas town; they find themselves in the middle of a dangerous feud between two families.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E20 — The Fear Merchants
A potential mayoral candidate attempts to stir up trouble between majority and minority groups in town.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E21 — Spanish Grant
A former dance hall girl poses as a Spanish heiress to claim a land grant that includes part of the Ponderosa; guest Sebastian Cabot.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E22 — Blood on the Land
Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E23 — Desert Justice
A Ponderosa ranch hand faces charges of killing the wife of the U.S. marshal who came to arrest him.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E24 — The Stranger
As Ben prepares to run for governor, Joe must come to his rescue when a disabled police officer from New Orleans comes to arrest Ben on a 20-year-old murder charge.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E25 — Escape to the Ponderosa
Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E26 — The Avenger
A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E27 — The Last Trophy
Two British socialites find that they still have a lot to learn when they visit their friends, the Cartwrights.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E28 — San Francisco
Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E29 — Bitter Water
When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E30 — Feet of Clay
The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E31 — Dark Star
Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E32 — Death at Dawn
A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E01 — Showdown
A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E02 — The Mission
Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S05 E22 — A Message From Abe
A reformed outlaw becomes concerned when financial problems prevent him from adequately caring for his sick wife.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E01 — Enter, the Lone Ranger
A co-worker of outlaw Butch Cavendish leads six Texas Rangers into an ambush.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E02 — The Lone Ranger Fights On
Tonto and the masked man catch up with Cavendish and his gang.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E03 — The Lone Ranger's Triumph
The Lone Ranger and Tonto capture the Cavendish gang.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E04 — Legion of Old Timers
Schemers want to take over a young Easterner's inherited property.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E05 — Rustler's Hideout
Outlaws demand their leader's release in return for a boy's life.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E06 — War Horse
Madrigo captures Chief Lame Bear's horse and his son.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E07 — Pete and Pedro
A ruthless man plans to gain control over a young woman's property.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E08 — The Renegades
Army deserters plan to kill Tonto and Chief Swift Eagle.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E09 — The Tenderfeet
Two greenhorns from the East are blamed for murder and claim jumping.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E10 — High Heels
The Lone Ranger teaches an important lesson to a man who's sensitive about his short stature.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E11 — Six-Gun's Legacy
Tonto and the Lone Ranger reveal an imposter's true identity.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E12 — Return of the Convict
A bitter man returns home after finishing a prison sentence for a crime he didn't commit.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E13 — Finders Keepers
The Lone Ranger risks his life for a man framed into robbing a bank.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E14 — The Masked Rider
A disguised outlaw, calling himself the Lone Ranger, commits murder.

title: The Lone Ranger
description:
S01 E15 — Old Joe's Sister
Thieves hungry for money throw a wealthy man over a cliff.

title: The Lone Ranger

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E11 — The Pickle Story
Andy, Barney and Opie substitute Aunt Bee's terrible homemade pickles with store-bought ones to avoid eating hers. Their plan backfires when Aunt Bee decides to enter them in the county fair.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E12 — Sheriff Barney
A trial run as sheriff of Mayberry convinces Barney that he is not ready for a similar job in a nearby town.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E13 — The Farmer Takes a Wife
Andy and Barney help Jeff, a farmer visiting Mayberry, search for a bride by cleaning him up and teaching him proper etiquette. Unfortunately for Barney, Jeff chooses Thelma Lou as his wife.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E14 — The Keeper of the Flame
Opie joins a secret club and is responsible for the candle they use in their meetings. When the barn the club meets in is burned to the ground, Opie is accused of starting the fire.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E15 — Bailey's Bad Boy
Andy teaches Ronald Bailey, the spoiled son of a rich man, the importance of being self-reliant and responsible.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E16 — The Manicurist
After a shaky start, male patrons accept the addition of a manicurist to Floyd's barbershop.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E17 — The Jinx
A Mayberry resident is convinced he is a jinx until Andy helps restore his self-confidence.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E18 — Jailbreak
Mayberry's small-town methods prove more effective in capturing a fugitive than those of the state police.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E19 — A Medal for Opie
Opie signs up for a race to win a medal, but he loses and learns an important lesson in good sportsmanship instead.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E20 — Barney and the Choir
Andy's diplomacy and modern engineering techniques are required to upgrade the music of the town choir.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E21 — Guest of Honor
To celebrate Founder's Day, Andy and Barney decide to choose a stranger at random to be Mayberry's Guest of Honor. Unbeknownst to them, the person they have chosen turns out to be a pickpocket.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S02 E22 — The Merchant of Mayberry
Andy uses his wits to help a struggling salesman, despite strong pressure to put him out of business.

title: Log Cabin Fever
description:
S01 E01 — A Home On A Hill
The crew builds a rustic new home for a young married couple at the top of a mountain, but they discover that getting their equipment up the treacherous roads is as difficult as building the cabin itself.

title: Log Cabin Fever
description:
S01 E03 — Pennsylvania Barn Demolition
The crew takes on its biggest job ever when they attempt to tear down a massive barn owned by an Army veteran and his family, who love the old barn but realize that its glory days have long since passed.

title: Log Cabin Fever
description:
S01 E04 — Collecting Barn Beams In Pennsylvania
Charlie discovers a mother lode of historic beams inside a dilapidated barn in Pennsylvania while tearing it down.

title: Log Cabin Fever
description:
S01 E05 — Searching For Historic Wood In Amish Country
Charlie and the crew travel deep into the backwoods of Tennessee mountain country to tear down an American Revolution-era log cabin.

title: Log Cabin Fever
description:
S01 E06 — Revisiting and Repairing Charlie's Log Cabins
Charlie revisits a massive log cabin vacation home to replace rotting timber; Charlie and his wife, Beth, visit a wedding reception cabin retreat; the crew creates a cabin-like television screening room for Charlie's old college buddy and his wife.
